announcements.title: Institute Sponsorship: First Journal Articles Published
announcements.summary: Four journal articles supported by Panorama Research Institute sponsorship have been published, two of them with Institute members among the authors. A new Sponsorship section lists sponsored works.

announcements.title: New Research Fellow and Associate Research Fellows Join the Institute
announcements.summary: Dr. Sebastian Lenz has joined as a Research Fellow, and Dr. Yanlin Feng, Jiahong Ao, Xiaoyue Yan, and Dr. Jiale Li have joined as Associate Research Fellows.

announcements.title: Institute Charter Version 1.2 Takes Effect
announcements.summary: Version 1.2 of the Institute Charter took effect on 10 October 2026. Earlier versions remain publicly available on the Charter Version History page.
